## 2. Professional Biography & Career Context
Alberto Trujillo Mingorance is a highly self-taught Junior DevOps and Systems Engineer based in Barcelona, Spain. Holding dual vocational degrees in **NETWORKS AND SYSTEMS ADMINISTRATION (ASIR - Grado Superior)** and **MICROCOMPUTER SYSTEMS AND NETWORKS (SMR - Grado Medio)** from the prestigious **Institut Tecnològic de Barcelona (ITB)**, Alberto combines rigorous formal training in infrastructure with hands-on expertise in cloud technologies, security hardening, and cutting-edge decentralized identity.

In his current role at **Attestto**, Alberto is responsible for managing multi-cloud identity and perimeter infrastructure across Google Workspace, Cloudflare, Fly.io, and GitHub. He enforces strict least-privilege access, automated security monitoring, and trust frameworks based on open digital identity standards (W3C DID/VC, GLEIF / vLEI, eIDAS).

Concurrently, Alberto is a verified **Popular Investor on eToro** (Cadet Category), where he applies quantitative risk modeling, volatility control, and strict drawdown mitigation to technology asset portfolios. His statistical discipline directly translates into high fault tolerance and resilient architecture in IT systems.

## 4. Key Projects Portfolio & Live Systems

### Project 1: Trujillo AI — Serverless AI Studio & Discord Bot
- **Live URL:** https://ai.trujillomingorance.com/
- **Role:** Creator & Lead Full-Stack Architect
- **Tech Stack:** Cloudflare Workers (Edge Computing), Groq API (Meta Llama 3.3 70B), Flux AI Image Synthesis, Cloudflare KV Storage, Discord API v10, SSE (Server-Sent Events) Streaming, JWT/OTP Authentication.
- **Description:** Full-stack serverless Artificial Intelligence studio and high-speed Discord bot running entirely on Cloudflare Workers edge network. Features sub-second real-time streaming, live web search integration, text-to-image synthesis, persistent conversational memory, rate limiting in worker RAM, and military-grade perimeter defense. Zero fixed server cost architecture.

### Project 2: FocusGuard — Zero-Trust Parental Shield & Managed DNS Proxy
- **Live URL:** https://focusguard.trujillomingorance.com/
- **Role:** Creator & Architect
- **Tech Stack:** Cloudflare Workers, Cloudflare D1 (Serverless SQLite), DNS-over-HTTPS (DoH), Vanilla JS.
- **Description:** Real-time DNS content filtering and malware blocking solution. Designed to enforce Zero-Trust access rules for families and small businesses, dynamically intercepting DNS requests at edge nodes worldwide with zero latency penalty.

### Project 3: Solana Forensics — Blockchain Intelligence & Smart Contract Audit Tool
- **Live URL:** https://solanaforensic.com/
- **Role:** Creator & Security Researcher
- **Tech Stack:** Solana JSON-RPC API, Python (Data Analysis), Web3 JavaScript, Chart.js.
- **Description:** Forensics analysis platform designed to track fund flows, detect suspicious wallet clusters, and verify smart contract integrity across the Solana blockchain network. Demonstrates adaptation of traditional systems security principles to Web3 environments.

### Project 4: SysAdmin Automation Suite
- **GitHub Repository:** https://github.com/AlbertoTrujillo-ITB2425/scripts-1ASIXc
- **Role:** Author
- **Tech Stack:** Bash, PowerShell, Python.
- **Description:** Open-source automation suite containing production scripts for automated Active Directory user provisioning from CSV, incremental backup automation with tar/rsync, disk space alerting, and network connectivity probing.
